summary.text: Daniel Quipp is the Democratic candidate for the Vermont House of Representatives, Windham-8 District, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Bill Harvey after winning the August 11 Democratic primary.
According to his campaign website, he is a four-term member of the Brattleboro Selectboard who built a career in education and anti-poverty services.

paragraphs.text: Daniel Quipp says on his campaign website that he grew up in Wrexham, UK, with his sister and single mother, and was one of the first in his family to attend college.
He began his career in education and later moved with his wife, Sarah, from London and Brooklyn to Brattleboro to be closer to family, becoming an American citizen after the 2016 election.
In Vermont he worked with young people and built a career in anti-poverty services, according to the site.
Quipp describes himself as a four-term Brattleboro Selectboard member.
In the August 11, 2026 Democratic primary he defeated Ken Fay, receiving 85.9 percent of the vote (531 votes).
His campaign website lists affordability, housing, health care, safe communities and quality of life as the issues he is focused on.
